sloka: भरतः च अपि तान् दूतान् एवम् उक्तः अभ्यभाषत ।आपृच्चे अहम् महा राजम् दूताः सम्त्वरयन्ति माम् ॥२-७०-१३॥
transliteration: bharataḥ ca api tān dūtān evam uktaḥ abhyabhāṣata ।āpṛcce aham mahā rājam dūtāḥ samtvarayanti mām ॥2-70-13॥

translations.english: Having thus been addressed, Bharata said to the messengers. Let me seek the permission of the great king of Kekaya to leave and say goodbye, informing him that the messengers are hastening me up.
